inspection_scope: Complete data-only review of the film_structure and all six beat contracts, covering rhetorical progression, narration coverage, setup boundaries, semantic centers, metaphor persistence, token lifecycles, composition diversity, dominant actions, hierarchy, and before/after states.

checks.evidence: Setup s1 makes one house explain six distinct rules: archiving, diff inspection, leak testing, permission, routing, and rollback. Each beat adds a separate machine rather than evolving one shared physical rule.

Every beat begins with the house and all earlier machines visible and ends by adding another machine while keeping every prior machine fully opaque and active. The obsolete mechanisms do not communicate the current operation or a meaningful cumulative quantity.

From b2 onward, the new hero mechanism must share the scene with multiple unrelated, still-active mechanisms. These do not form one repeated semantic group: archive, diff lens, water tank, permission gate, pipeline, and rewind crank represent separate claims.

All six unrelated propositions use the same central slab, small Bot at left, fixed wide camera, and paper wall/floor. Neither the retained house nor the identical framing has a continuity function sufficient to justify this repetition.

Although s1 declares no continuity tokens, the house and every completed machine persist across all beats as undeclared continuity objects. Their origin, state changes, ordered use, and destination are not recorded, and their continued activity obscures each new hero.

Previously used machines remain fully opaque and active after their propositions finish, but the plan assigns them no current story, location, action, or balance function. The repeated receipt-pile focal target and pricing/receipt depth cues are also unrelated to the stated operations.

The semantic rule changes at every proposition—save, inspect, test, authorize, route, and restore—yet s1 provides no reset until the end. Receipt settling is repeated as exit overlap even though receipts are not the meaningful result of these operations.

Each beat specifies a new dominant mechanism while all earlier mechanisms remain active. In addition, every contract names the unrelated receipt pile as focal_target, conflicting with the declared hero and primary action.

Each proposition has a planned central physical action that can convey its core verb without captions: placing a snapshot in an archive, revealing edited lines, testing for leaks, releasing a permission gate, routing an output, and retrieving an earlier roof state.

setup_assessments.evidence: The single setup spans six unrelated semantic rules, accumulates every completed mechanism, repeats one composition, lacks meaningful resets and token lifecycles, and creates competing active regions.

violations.observation: One persistent house is asked to contain separate archive, diff, test, permission, routing, and rollback machines.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Split s1 into distinct setups when the semantic rule changes; retain only a meaningful artifact such as the saved snapshot or changed output when a handoff is needed.

violations.observation: Every new machine is added while all earlier machines remain fully opaque and active, without representing cost, workload, history, or another intentional accumulation.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Remove or replace each completed mechanism when its proposition ends; carry forward only the artifact required by the next operation.

violations.observation: Unrelated operating groups remain simultaneously dominant as new claims arrive.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Give each operation one dominant mechanism in its own setup, or regroup only genuinely adjacent operations that can evolve under one rule.

violations.observation: Six unrelated propositions repeat the central slab, small-left Bot, wide camera, and paper wall/floor staging.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Recompose at semantic boundaries using operation-specific dominant silhouettes and scales—for example isolated inspection, gate interaction, route field, and restore comparison.

violations.observation: The house and all prior machines behave as persistent tokens despite no declared lifecycle or later semantic use.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Declare and track only the prior-state snapshot and/or current output as continuity tokens, with explicit state changes and destinations; leave the old sets behind.

violations.observation: Obsolete machines, the repeated receipt-pile focal target, and pricing/receipt cues remain despite lacking a function in the software-operation argument.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Remove unrelated retained geometry and cues from each setup; keep only elements supporting the current operation, location, action, or balance.

violations.observation: No reset occurs between six changes of semantic rule, and the repeated receipt-settling overlap does not provide a meaningful handoff.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Insert resets at the major rule changes and connect related setups only through a meaningful artifact, such as snapshot to comparison or failed output to restoration.

violations.observation: The new hero, all previously active machinery, and the receipt-pile focal target compete in the same wide frame.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Make the current operation the sole dominant active region, deactivate or remove obsolete machinery, and align focal_target with the declared hero or its result.

limits: This data-only review can assess planned structure and hierarchy but cannot establish rendered visibility, actual mobile-glance performance, animation execution, pixel-level occlusion, or listening experience.
